address: La Route de la Baie, Saint Brelade, JE3 8EF, United Kingdom
bio: One of the best things about Oyster Box is that it really reminds you that you're on an island. The location looking out over St Brelade's Bay is magnificent, with the terrace in particular offering some of the finest sea views you'll find – and the food is a perfect match for the setting, with bright, fresh dishes featuring top-drawer seafood. Jersey rock oysters are an obvious must-order, but the rest of the dishes are equally enticing; it's worth keeping an eye on the fish of the day and if you order the terrific crab taglierini, you won't be disappointed....
